note: Storage list methods with nothing to bound what they return, and the calls outside src/storage that read a whole table through one (scripts/check-unbounded-lists.ts). Seeded 2026-10-20 from the QA audit of 2026-10-16 (P7-10). An entry under methods is DEBT, a known unbounded read nobody has judged yet, or the reason the list cannot grow. Answering one means giving the method a limit and a cursor, or replacing DEBT with that reason. wholeTableCalls counts calls with no arguments per file; a count may only fall, and the gate fails until a fallen count is lowered here. The counts of services/account-event-task-keep.ts, services/app/tool-invoke-keep.ts, services/knowledge-link-owner-keep.ts, services/datapackage/audience-record.ts and services/portfolio-read-hold-keep.ts are once-only start steps (server-bootstrap/once-only-keep-steps.ts): each reads those tables whole once per node, before the node serves, and never in a request. The count of services/place-agent-scopes.ts (givePlaceDefaultToEveryAgent, decision 8b of 2026-11-05) reads the agent table whole only on a store place: at each start, before the node serves, and in the one request that sets site.purchase_plan, which the store's fleet service makes once per node; off a store place it reads nothing. Re-seeding forgives every entry, so it is a decision to ask about, never maintenance. On 2026-11-04 the gate began to decide a bound from the parameter's TYPE (an options type with a limit, cursor or page field, or a scalar named limit, since, after and the like) instead of from its name, which had counted any parameter called opts, query or filter as a bound (codebase analysis 2026-11-03, item C1). The 27 entries added that day are not new debt: they are lists the old name test could not see, entered as DEBT. The count went from 69 to 96.

contentLists.listAppsWithContent: Reads the latest version of each app WITH its bytes, by design: the operator's copy scan compares apps' content (routes/apps/catalogue-admin.ts) and the one-time app scope allowance reads each app's code (services/app/scope-allowance.ts). Operator-only and boot-time callers, paged by limit; listApps is the catalogue's door without the bytes.
contentLists.listAppVersions: Reads every version of one app WITH its bytes, by design: the owner's backup export writes each version's content into the archive (services/apps-backup-export.ts). The version list reads listAppVersionSummaries and the import preview listAppVersionSizes (codebase analysis 2026-11-03, item A1).
